title: std::vector<bool>'s operator[] returns a proxy — generic code surprises
notes:
Per the STL mapping table, std::vector<bool> maps to BitArray
(.NET) / BitSet (Java) — NOT List<bool> / ArrayList<Boolean>.
Missing this distinction silently changes the API contract (the
proxy-reference dance disappears in the target). Forces the
edge_case + template_instantiation kinds to fire together,
verifying the schema's cross-claim coordination.
